subject: Re: Prep for June leadership review — service economics & readiness
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@acme-platforms.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly leadership prep — quick sync request

Hi Kimberly,

Hope youre well. Were finalizing the agenda for the June 6 leadership touchpoint and wanted to check whether the Redwood team can give a 12-minute readout focused on: latency trends (p95/p99 across regions), recent cost deltas after the May batching changes, and any uptime incidents that could impact our SLA for the quarter.

Could you share a short dashboard PDF and a single-slide summary by EOD Thursday? Samantha (procurement) will also want any changes to usage commitments that affect pricing tiers.

Happy to slot a 20-minute pre-brief if that helps.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Platforms

[External]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@acme-platforms.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly leadership prep — quick sync request

Samantha, thanks for the heads up — we can cover that. Action plan below: 

- Markus will attach a one-page dashboard PDF (p95/p99, cost delta, regional breakdown).
- Jonas will pull uptime/incident highlights and note any active mitigations.
- Ill prepare the usage-commitments impact note for procurement.

Can you confirm whether you want raw token-level cost or just rolling-month delta? Also, is the pre-brief on Thursday morning or afternoon? We have a leadership slot 11:30-11:50 PT that day.

If that works well deliver the PDF + single-slide by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: service-dashboard-jun2028.pdf (PDF)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly leadership prep — quick sync request

Team, attaching the dashboard and a short spreadsheet with the cost breakout. High-level notes: 

- Latency: p95 improved ~12% since the batching parameter tweak (most visible on longer sequences >512). p99 shows a modest improvement (4%) but we still see tail spikes tied to cross-AZ network retries.
- Cost: month-over-month token cost per 1MM tokens down 6% after batching + prefix caching, but effective spend rose 3% due to a 10% increase in overall usage from a single large partner job.
- Uptime: two brief incidents (2028-05-22 and 2028-05-27) caused ~18 minutes of customer-facing errors (partial redundancy failover took longer than expected). Incident owners have postmortems in progress; mitigation includes a routing tweak and an autoscaler policy hold.

Attachments: service-dashboard-jun2028.pdf, latency-cost-breakdown-0528.xlsx

Questions for leadership pre-brief: 
1) Approve temporary burst capacity for the partner job through June to avoid SLA churn? (estimated incremental monthly cost $12k)
2) Greenlight a short networking pilot with infra team to reduce cross-AZ retries (2-week trial).

--
Markus Klein
Head of Production Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: latency-cost-breakdown-0528.xlsx (Excel)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@acme-platforms.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly leadership prep — quick sync request

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few quick leadership asks ahead of June 6: 

- Kimberly: include a one-slide brief on OKR progress tied to the service-economics objective (owner, current status, blocker).
- Markus: add an explicit row in the spreadsheet showing net unit cost after partner offset (so finance can model the burst ask).
- Jonas: summarize the two incidents in 3 bullets with timeline and customer impact (who was affected, mitigation, RCA ETA).

Samantha: well send the consolidated PDF and the single slide by Monday EOD so you can circulate to your executive team. If leadership wants the pre-brief on Thursday 11:30-11:50 PT that works for us; Kimberly to confirm in a separate note.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
